tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru/ bka' pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa/ grub thob rnams kyi zhal gdams/ man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul du gsungs pa/ zab don thugs gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku spros bral smra bsam brjod med nam mkha'i dbyings/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dang dpe byad rab ldan zhing*/ /gang la gang 'dul cir yang sprul pas gzhan don mdzad/ /stong nyid snying rje smon lam mthar phyin zhabs la 'dud/ /bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa theg pa chen po'i chos/ /'khor 'das dgag sgrub med pa pha rol phyin pa'i don/ /'gal rkyen lam du 'khyer ba a ma jo mos bzhed/ /mi mthun grogs su 'dod pa gcod kyi gdams pa bri/ /tshig don rtogs shing byams brtse rab rgyas mkhas brgyad ldan/ /rang don mthar phyin stong nyid snying rje sgrub dang rkyen sel mkhas/ /dad ldan brtson 'grus mos gus go cha snying rus ldan/ /'jigs skyob mngon mtho legs smon kun mkhyen thob 'dod pa/ /dbang bskur mchog thob zab mo nyan des snod du gyur/ /bsags sbyangs lam gyis sems nyid rtsal sbyong ngo sprod bya/ /ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs the tshom gcad bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i lam 'di skal ldan rnams kyis nges par zungs/ /bdud ni lha dang nyon mongs phung po 'chi bdag bdud/ khyad par thogs bcas thogs med dga' brod snyems byed bdud/ /dur khrod lung stong lha khang shing gcig khang stong sogs/ /rang sems gang 'jigs nyam nga bag tsha'i gnas su nyal/ /mtshan mo nyam nga lha 'dre 'du zhing rnam rtog skye/ /the tshom gcod dang gegs sel bogs 'don tshe na bya/ /kun mkhyen 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro dang gsol ba gdab/ /sems bskyed mchog ldan 'gro kun thar pa thob pa'i lam/ /gnas po bdud la bcol bas gzhi mgron gcig tu 'dres/ /skyel ma dgra la bcol bas 'jigs med btsan sar thar/

/nad pa 'dre la bcol bas nad med bde bar 'tsho/ /lam khyer rkyen la byas pas mi mthun 'gal rkyen bral/ /phung po gzan du bskyur bas gces 'dzin blo dang bral/ /lus sems so sor phral bas bdag 'dzin mkhan po stor/ /'jigs mkhan rtsa brdar bcad pas nyams nga rang sar yal/ /lus kyi bdag 'dzin bor bas bar chad dpal du shar/ /rkyen la rkyang 'ded byas pas bar chad stong par zhi/ /gdon la spar zin byas pas 'jigs yul dngos po stor/ /thams cad sems su shes pas 'dzin med rang sar grol/ /rang gar bskyur nas btang na sus kyang 'khyer mi srid/ /gang tshe chos nyid don la mnyam par sus bzhag pa/ /de tshe bdud tshogs mi bzod cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ /phyi nang gsang ba mngon sum nyams snang rmi lam du/ /sna tshogs gzugs bstan mi snyan sgra sgrog lus ston 'gyur/ /sems la khu 'phrig byung na bdag 'dzin yul nas thon/ /nang 'dre rang sems 'dul na phyi 'dre stong par yal/ /ma phod mi nus byung na mgo snyoms thog rdzis bya/ /nyam nga bag tsha byung na rnam rtog ar la gtad/ /cho 'phrul che nas ma zug gcod 'phro bcad pa dang*/ /'gyod dang the tshom lta log chos kyis sun pa dang*/ /na tsha sdug bsngal khams 'dus nyams len stor ba rnams/ /log rtog bar chad 'byung bas 'bad rtsol bton la sgrubs/ /log chen mtha' la gtad pas re dogs rang sar grol/ /theg chen zil gyis mnan pas bde sdug gtan la phebs/ /skar chen theb 'og bcug pas 'khor 'das rdzun phug rdib/ /gnyan sar gnyan thog phabs pas lha 'dre sgyu mar zhig /gdug rtsub cho 'phrul che na lha 'dre ar la mnan/ /ci nas glan ka brko na smyon pa'i brtul zhugs gyis/ /de ru cho 'phrul ston na bde shi skyid bya/ /kun la byams pa'i sems kyis thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ /tshar tshad dus rtags mngon sum nyams ltas rmi lam byung*/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rang la 'char bar rig par bya/

/stong nyid ngang du rtse gcig bsam gtan mnyam bzhag bya/ /'khor 'das kun gyi 'khrul shan phyed par the tshom med/ /sngon 'gro slong rtags med na slong pa'i blo dang phrol/ /dngos gzhi non rtags med na zhe 'dod rgyab tu bskyur/ /mjug tu tshar tshad med na tshar 'dod blo dang phrol/ /'dod blo re dogs bdud yin mkhas pas spang bar bya/ /phan dang gnod bcas 'jam dang rtsub pa'i spyod pas brtul/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis byang chub la bkod smon lam btab/ /bdag gzhan don du kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob 'dod pas/ /thar pa'i lam 'di skal ldan rnams kyis bsten par gyis/ /yun ring goms pa'i bag chags spang dka' rnam rtog 'di/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs skyed pa'i rgyu gcig po/ /rten dang brten par phung khams 'dus pa'i dur khrod 'dir/ /'gyu byed dran rtog sna tshogs rgyu ba'i gnas 'dir bcad/ /dbang don ngo sprod mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ji srid rnam rtog bdud 'di ma chod de srid bcad/ /gdod nas chos nyid glo bur dri ma dang bcas pa/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum brtags la lta sgom spyod pas gzhom/ /chos nyid gtan la 'bebs tshe rnam rtog gnod pa mang*/ /shes bya'i yul du sna tshogs dran rtog 'du 'phro 'byung*/ /rtogs pa'i dpung dang mi ldan sgom pa'i nyams dang bral/ /rkyen la gcod pas thog rdzis ro snyom ma byung bzlog /'gyu byed sdong po lta sgom spyod pa'i mtshon gyis bcad/ /sems byung rnam rtog yal ga thams cad ngang gis 'gags/ /tsha zer 'od kyis rlan dang mun pa 'joms pa bzhin/ /ye shes shar bas skyon spangs sa lam rim gyis bgrod/ /rang bzhin mi rtogs bsgyur mkhas gnyen pos spong nus shing*/ /stong nyid snying rje byang chub sems ldan mchod par shes/ / bdud dang 'byung pos ngan 'gro'i gnas su khrid mi nus/ /nyon mongs bdud kyis srid pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed phyir gzhom/

/gnas ni rang lus rtsa khams 'dus pa'i gnyan khrod na/ /nyon mongs 'byung po rten dang brten pa'i tshul du gnas/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer rab rgyas te/ /ji srid ma rig mun khrod ma sangs bar du gcad/ /gang tshe nyon mongs skyes tshe lta sgom spyod pa yis/ /gnyen pos bzung na de tshe bdud las rnam rgyal bya/ /ji ltar ro mi mthun pa'i zas kyis nad slong ltar/ /chags sdang nyon mongs nyams len rkyen gyis slong bar 'gyur/ /chos la bzod pa ma thob lam gyi rkyen gyis 'jig /'gyod dang the tshom log lta chos kyis sun pa 'byung*/ /nyon mongs skyes tshe thabs dang shes rab log non gyis/ /stong dang bsgyur thabs mchod par rtogs pa gnyen po'i mchog /srid pa'i drwa ba nyon mongs rgya mtsho mi bzad pa/ /ma lus rab bcom ye shes ro mnyam mchog gi tshad/ /dad dang snying rje don rtogs gdams pa'i gnad dang ldan/ /thar pa thob pa'i thabs su rnal 'byor rnams kyis bcad/ /nad dang du kha: dug ro drag po kun gyi bdud/ /de nyid ma rtogs thar pa thob pa'i srog 'phrog byed/ /bde sdug skyon yon 'khor 'das thams cad skyed pa'i rten/ /'byung bzhi nyon mongs rlung mkhris bad kan phung po'i gnas/ /lus ngag yid la nad dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen zug rngu drag pos mnar ba'i tshe/ /nad dang sdug bsngal nyes skyon ma lus 'byung ba'i rten/ /lus sems gnyis yin de nyid phral na grol bar nges/ /sdigs mdzub bstan pas sbrul gyis mi bzod stong nyid don/ /gang gis sgom de'i nad gdon mi bzod zhi zhing 'bros/ /gang tshe nad dang sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba'i tshe/ /de tshe gdengs bral zhum bcas brtson pa dor na ldog /sems kyi dbang po nyams rtogs ldan pa'i stobs rtsal rgyas/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i lta sgom go mtshon bdud dpung 'joms/ /thabs shes lam khyer zab mos nad dang sdug bsngal zhi/

/skyon bral yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar rab rgyas 'gyur/ /rtogs pa'i gdengs ldan nyams kyi ngar bcas mang du thos/ /snying khams gtong phod dad khams dpa' rtsal brtul zhugs can/ /nad dang dgra gdon grib dang chos brgyad chags sdang sogs/ /'jig rten mi mthun sna tshogs bdud la gcad par bya/ /rang gi yul dang grong yul rgyal khams dgon pa dang*/ khang pa la sogs nyon mongs gang du skye bar gcad/ /dus ni ring thung thang po'i dus dang byang chub bar/ /ji srid bde sdug skyon dang 'gal rkyen byung ba'i tshe/ /nad dang gdon dang nyam grib chos brgyad bde sdug sogs/ /rang bzhin med sgom las su shes pas lam du 'khyer/ /nad dang sdug bsngal sngar bas mang zhing rags pa dang*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun sna tshogs 'byung*/ /rgyu 'bras gdams ngag dge ba'i bshes la the tshom za/ /rkyen la 'jigs shing lam gyi chos kyis sun pa dang*/ /med bzhin snang ba'i bdud 'di ci phyir bdag la gnod/ /dngos med 'khrul pa'i dgra 'di yid kyi gnyen pos 'joms/ /srid pa'i nyon mongs chags sdang bdud 'di tshar chod na/ /bde legs kun 'byung yon tan kun gyi gter kha 'byed/ /bsags sbyangs la 'bad bag chags 'don pas rmi lam bzung*/ /zin par gyur tshe sbyangs dang spel zhing 'od gsal bsgom/ /rlung dang rnam shes gyen la 'dren pa 'pho ba'i lam/ /phra rags thim rjes 'od gsal 'char ba bar do yin/ /lha 'dre 'khrugs pas lus nad sems skyon sna tshogs 'byung*/ /gnyen po'i dpung ldan stong nyid sbyin gtong mnyam nyid bsgom/ /las kyi rgyu dang nyon mongs rkyen gyis nad rnams 'byung*/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor thabs dang dmigs pas 'don par bya/ khams 'dus sdug bsngal 'byams dang ltengs pa yid kyi skyon/ /thabs dang rten 'brel rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor dmigs pas gzhom/ /mos gus dpag med snying rje rgya chen 'gal rkyen la/

/thog 'gel byas pas yon tan kun gyi bogs su 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gcod yul mchog 'di sus 'dzin pa/ /thar pa'i lam ster yon tan dpag med rgya chen 'byung*/ /zab rgyas kun khyab kun la khyab pa'i dam chos 'di/ /rten dang grub mtha' kun mthun skyon spang khyad par 'phags/ /gang zhig nor bu rnyed tshe gces par 'dzin pa ltar/ /rin chen rin thang med pa'i chos 'di gus pas zung/ /gcod kyi gzhung mang zab rgyas rgya mtsho rgya chen las/ /nyung bsdus zab don thugs kyi snying po 'di bkod pas/ /'gro kun gcod yul mthar phyin gcod don 'di rtogs te/ /chos dbyings rnam dag pha rol phyin yum mchog thob shog /bka' shes rab gyi pha rol du phyin pa'i dgongs pa/ bla ma grub thob rnams kyi zhal gdams/ bdud gcod yul du byed pa'i man ngag zab don thugs kyi snying po zhes bya ba 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' ba'i chos/ man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul du byed pa rdzogs so// // kun mkhyen dri med pas mdzad pa'i gcod yul rig 'dzin padma gling pa las thob pa'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)zab don gyi gzhung*/ - PAGE 130 -- PAGE 129 -- PAGE 124 -
